message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "enforce_imaging_tool_invocation", "description": "When the task requires interpreting medical imaging data (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI) and relevant analysis tools are available, the agent must invoke those tools instead of relying on internal knowledge or hallucinating modality details.", "applicable_conditions": "The user input contains or references medical imaging data, and the task category is 'medical_imaging_interpretation' or similar diagnostic tasks requiring visual analysis.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the task involves interpreting medical images: (1) Identify the specific imaging modality (e.g., Chest X-ray) from the input context; (2) Select the appropriate analysis tool from the available toolkit (e.g., `chest_xray_classifier` for detection, `chest_xray_report_generator` for structured reporting); (3) Invoke the selected tool with the image data as input. Do NOT attempt to interpret the image content directly using internal knowledge or assume a different modality (e.g., treating an X-ray as a CT scan) without tool verification."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
